patterns.note: Full-bleed aspirational lifestyle imagery is used for hero sections, often with text overlays and a clear call-to-action.
Sections alternate between light and dark background colors (white, dark blue, dark green, light yellow) to create visual separation and rhythm.
A distinctive, organic serif font is used for prominent headings, providing an elegant and approachable brand voice, contrasted with clean sans-serif for body text.
A warm, bright orange is consistently used as the primary accent color for all call-to-action buttons and key interactive elements.
A secondary navigation bar with product categories becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Product display sections utilize a grid of consistently styled cards, each featuring an image, product title, and a 'Shop Now' button.

technique_notes: The secondary navigation bar transitions from its initial position to a fixed, sticky position at the top of the viewport with a subtle background as the user scrolls down the page. Other content sections appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated using CSS keyframe animations.

High-quality lifestyle photography and abstract scientific-inspired visuals are used as full-bleed backgrounds or prominent elements within sections, often with text placed directly over them, relying on good contrast or subtle overlays.
Call-to-action buttons are designed with a consistent bright orange fill and white text, ensuring high visibility and a clear interactive target across the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by clean sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle for buttons and input fields, sharp for most section edges and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with airy hero sections and comfortable padding around content blocks, creating a sense of openness and ease of reading.

standout: The site distinctively blends aspirational lifestyle imagery with abstract, scientific-inspired visuals to convey both the emotional benefits and the scientific credibility of its products. The use of an organic, friendly serif font for main headings gives the brand a unique, approachable yet authoritative voice, setting it apart from typical health and wellness brands that often rely solely on clean sans-serif typography.
